description: Organizations on Platform (organizations design §10, §11), on the ceremony of dti-2of3.json. Generated by tools/org-vectors/gen.mjs (platform); shared by forge-core::org and forge-web/lib/org.

rules.proofMessage:
UTF-8 of "dash-forge/org-member/1
<network>
<org base58>
<$ownerId base58>", Ed25519 by authPub
rules.sealedShare: orgShare.sealed: XChaCha20-Poly1305, key HKDF-SHA256(ikm = 64-byte BIP-39 seed, salt "dash-forge/org-share/1", info "<network>\n<org base58>\n<cid hex>", 32 bytes), plaintext the 32-byte big-endian secret share of the signing slot, stored nonce(24) || ciphertext || tag(16)
rules.payload: canonical JSON of the envelope as UTF-8; fmt 1 = deflate-raw of it, one stream ending exactly at the payload end; parts of at most maxPart bytes; digest = SHA-256 of the whole stored payload; inflated at most maxPayload bytes. Writers use fmt 1 when it is shorter. A message copy counts at its last part's $createdAt.
rules.shares: a member opens the orgShare of one of its bound identities whose cid is the signing ceremony, and checks the opened share against its public share
rules.memberIdentities: an orgMember counts when org matches, authPub is a roster member and proof verifies for its $ownerId (checked before the cap); at most maxIdentitiesPerKey per authPub, earliest $createdAt (then $id) first; one identity may bind several keys (byOrg is org, $ownerId, authPub)
rules.requestIds: every Forge request id is <group>-<first 16 hex of the proposer auth key>; a bare group resolves when exactly one proposer used it; a proposal without a Forge note is its own request, id = proposal id
rules.status: invalid (structural or review problems) > declined > done (every part done or gone) > expired (any part expired) > ready (every part ready, done or gone) > collecting

sealedShares.name: another member seed does not open it
another network does not open it
another organization does not open it
a changed tag does not open

messages.name: a proposal over 5120 bytes deflated, still two parts
a repetitive proposal over 5120 bytes deflates to one part

reassembly.name: a part from another identity does not complete it
parts that disagree on the part count
a repeated part with the same body is fine
a repeated part with another body: the earliest counts

merge.note: Envelopes count only from the log of an identity bound (orgMember) to the envelope `from`. A copy of a message is complete at its last part's $createdAt; each envelope is ordered by its earliest complete copy, then envelope id; that time is the `at` the request flow shows and orders approvals by.

resolve.why: a bare group id resolves when exactly one proposer used it
an unambiguous prefix of at least 4 characters

status.partRules: doc: absent; present (delete: the document exists); same / different (create: at revision 1 with / without the part's fields; replace: at the part's revision with / without them); base (replace: at the revision it replaces); later (past the part's revision). expired: takenByOther (wins over everything below). landed: create or replace same, or later with nonce spent and a claim; delete absent with nonce spent and a claim. done: landed. gone: create, claim, nonce spent, doc absent. expired: nonce spent, a create whose document exists but has not landed, a replace whose document is not at base, or a delete whose document is gone. ready: shares >= N. else collecting.
